name: nipopow-mixed
description: The nipopow-mixed scenario (a NiPoPoW-bootstrapping joiner on one jar against serving peers on the other jar, both directions; same script, same result name) with the opposite expectation: for a candidate whose proofs the base accepts and which accepts the base's, the joiner applies the served proof in both arms. Whether it also rejected a proof is in the metrics (rejected, penalties) and is read from them, not judged.
